name: Git Araçları
author: Orbital
description: Git iş akışı için komutlar, araç çubuğu eylemleri ve bir skill.

commit.template: Run `git status` and `git diff --staged` (or `git diff` if nothing is staged). Write a Conventional Commits message for these changes. Do not commit. $ARGUMENTS

changelog.template: Run `git log --oneline -n 20` and summarize the changes as a user-facing changelog grouped by Added / Changed / Fixed. $ARGUMENTS
